title: World trade explorer
meta_description: Use our interactive to understand how the UK trades with the rest of the world.
lede: Use our interactive to understand how the UK trades with the rest of the world.

body.text: In 2021 the UK had a trade deficit with the rest of the world, which means we imported more from other countries than we exported to them.
This overall deficit was made up of a large deficit in goods, partly offset by a surplus in services.

Use our interactive to explore UK trade relationships with the rest of the world. Select a country by using the dropdown or hovering over the map and see total UK trade with that country broken down by goods and services.
